name: Mercenary Stormlash
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Stormlash (players/warlock/mercenary/stormlash_merc.sval, 22 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 2 (in brackets): any skill hit at 30% for a flat 20 (lightning bolts at 50% for 50% damage). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Skill hits have a 30% chance to strike a random enemy within 80 with lightning for 20 magical damage.
